deviations.what: qwen3_coder_thinking plugin: on engines that hold the structured-output grammar until reasoning ends (vLLM >= 0.30.0; seen on 0.30.0, 0.31.0 and eugr 0.32.0rc1) the plugin must pass reasoning=False, because its thinking-prefixed grammar otherwise waits for a second </think> and masks EOS, so strict+thinking repeats the tool call until max_tokens; the old nightly keeps the per-request derivation.
